About.heroDesc: Our passion for excellence is what drives us at Discount Tower. We treat every piece of candy as a work of art to create unforgettable moments.
About.storyP1: The story of Discount Tower started from a simple idea: offering baked goods and sweets that combine exceptional quality with affordable prices. We believe great taste should not only be available on special occasions, but should be part of your everyday joy.
About.storyP2: From day one, we relied on the most skilled chefs and bakers who inherited the craft's secrets, blending the authenticity of Eastern sweets with the elegance of Western confections. Every cake we bake, every cookie we make, carries a part of our love and passion.
About.storyP3: Today, we are proud to be a part of the memories of thousands of our customers at their weddings, birthdays, and warm family moments.

Offers.offer2Desc: Book the wedding cake with the accompanying sweets buffet and get an exclusive discount with free delivery to the venue.
Offers.offer3Desc: Plan your party with us! Get a free mini pastries box when you order a large event cake.

Services.heroDesc: At Discount Tower, we don't just sell sweets — we offer comprehensive services to ensure your occasions are perfect from start to finish.
Services.ctaTitle: Have a special request not listed?
Services.ctaDesc: Our flexible team is always ready to listen to your ideas and turn them into a delicious reality.
Services.service1Desc: We design your dream wedding cake and a complete sweets buffet that impresses your guests with premium decorations and delicious flavors.
Services.service2Desc: Birthdays, graduations, or any happy occasion. We make a custom-designed cake that truly represents you with an irresistible taste.
Services.service3Desc: Elegant and distinctive hospitality boxes suitable for business meetings and formal events to leave a great impression on your clients.
Services.service4Desc: We deliver your orders anywhere in Riyadh city in refrigerated vehicles to ensure sweets arrive fresh and looking their best.
